KeyHelm

Privacy policy

Effective 2026-10-20

This policy explains what personal information KeyHelm LLC ("KeyHelm", "we", "us") collects, why, who we share it with, and the choices you have. KeyHelm is software that helps rental owners in Colorado run their homes. It covers our website, the KeyHelm service, and the texts, emails and calls it sends and receives.

Who this covers

  • Owners: the landlords who subscribe to KeyHelm.
  • Tenants, applicants, prospects and vendors who message an owner's KeyHelm line, apply for a home, or are added by an owner. For this information we work on the owner's behalf: the owner decides how it is used, and we use it only to provide the service to them.
  • Website visitors.

Information we collect

FromWhat
OwnersName, email, mobile phone, number of homes, plan choice, the rules and policies you enter, property details, vendor contacts, lease templates, and records you create (such as marking rent received). When you sign up we record that you accepted our terms and whether you chose to get texts, and when.
Owners (billing)Payments are handled by Stripe. We receive your Stripe customer ID, subscription status and plan. We do not receive or store full card numbers.
Tenants, prospects, vendorsName, phone number, email address, the content of texts, emails and call transcripts sent to the owner's line, photos you send, and records about repairs, showings, leases, rent reminders and deposits.
Anyone who gets textsMobile number, whether and when you agreed to texts, and any STOP, START or HELP replies, so we can honor them.
ApplicantsName, email and phone from the application form. If the owner uses identity verification or tenant screening, the results from those partners are shared with the owner. KeyHelm does not score, rank or recommend applicants.
EveryoneTechnical information our servers and our website host (Squarespace) receive with each request, such as IP address, browser type and the page requested. We use it to keep the service running and secure, including limiting abusive traffic.

How we use it

  • To provide the service: answer and route messages for the owner, book repairs with the owner's vendors, send reminders and notices the owner has set up, prepare leases and deposit statements, and show the owner what needs a decision.
  • To bill owners for their KeyHelm subscription.
  • To keep the service secure, prevent fraud and abuse, and fix problems.
  • To meet legal obligations and enforce our terms.

Automated replies. KeyHelm uses an AI model to draft replies to messages. Replies are limited to the facts the owner has provided and to fixed rules. Topics such as fair housing, accommodation requests, complaints, legal matters and application decisions are passed to the owner instead of being answered automatically. We keep a log of these AI exchanges for up to 90 days to check quality and safety. We do not use your messages to train AI models; if that ever changes, we will update this policy first and ask for consent where the law requires it.

Who we share it with

We do not sell personal information, and we do not share it for targeted advertising. We share it only as needed to run the service:

  • The owner of the home you are messaging about, renting or applying for.
  • Vendors the owner chooses, when a repair needs them (for example, the address, the problem and a contact number).
  • Service providers who process it for us: Railway (app hosting), Squarespace (website hosting), Google Fonts (website fonts), Stripe (subscription payments), Anthropic (AI model that drafts replies), and, when enabled, Twilio (texts and calls), Postmark (email), Calendly (scheduling setup calls), smart-lock providers for self-guided showings, and the screening and identity verification partners an owner chooses.
  • Legal reasons: when required by law, to protect rights and safety, or as part of a sale or reorganization of our business (in which case this policy continues to apply).

Text messaging. No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. Text messaging originator opt-in data and consent are excluded from every sharing category in this policy and will not be shared with any third parties. Phone numbers are used only to send and receive the texts described on our text messages page.

Text messages

KeyHelm texts tenants, applicants, prospects, vendors and owners only about the rental homes and accounts described on our text messages page, never for marketing. Owners choose whether to get texts when they sign up; it is optional and not a condition of purchase. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to stop texts or HELP for help. We keep a record of consent and opt-outs so we can honor them.

Cookies and tracking

Our website is hosted by Squarespace. It does not use advertising cookies or advertising trackers. Squarespace sets cookies needed to run and secure the site and, only if you accept them in the cookie banner, analytics cookies that count visits for us. See our Cookie policy.

How long we keep it

  • AI exchange logs: up to 90 days.
  • Owner account information and the records in it: while the account is open. After an account closes, we delete or de-identify it within 90 days, unless we must keep certain records longer for legal, tax or dispute reasons.
  • Billing records: as long as tax and accounting law requires.

Your choices and rights

  • You can ask to see, correct, or delete your personal information, or for a copy of it, by emailing help@keyhelm.example. We will respond within 45 days. If your information is held for an owner (for example, as their tenant), we may pass your request to that owner.
  • Reply STOP to any text to stop receiving texts, or HELP for help.
  • Colorado residents may have additional rights under the Colorado Privacy Act. We do not sell personal data or use it for targeted advertising or profiling. If you are not satisfied with our answer to a request, you can appeal by replying to our response.

Security

We use encrypted connections (HTTPS) for our website and service and limit access to personal information to what is needed to run the service. No system is perfectly secure; if a breach affects your personal information, we will notify you as the law requires.

Children

KeyHelm is not meant for anyone under 18, and we do not knowingly collect information from children.

Changes

If we change this policy, we will update the effective date above. If the change is significant, we will tell owners by email before it takes effect.

Contact

KeyHelm LLC. Email help@keyhelm.example.
